resources.string: Shown while nature sounds are mixing in the background.
Wakes you at the time you set.
Other sounds are still in the mix.
Start the sounds you want to wake to, then Set Alarm.
* A demonstration video can be viewed by tapping on the YouTube link button below *
Click on the button with the name of the sound category you want to hear to display the sound options.
Click on the \'Stop All Sounds\' button to stop all sounds playing for the entire app.

Each sound is played by clicking on the corresponding Play button with the sound name displayed above it. The sound is stopped by clicking the same button, which reads Stop while the mixer is playing.
Adjust the volume for each sound by moving the slider to the left or right.
Some sounds offer volume range and delay range options. Adjusting the delay slider left or right will set a random selection of short sound files to be played at a delay you select in seconds.
Click on the \'Default Setting\' button to play a suggested set of sounds at recommended settings.
Clicking on the \'Stop All Sounds\' button at the top of the screen will stop all the sounds playing for the sound category.
The \'Current Time\' label is displaying the present time to you.

To set the alarm: 1 Play all of the sounds you want to hear at the desired volume and delay settings. 2 Then select the alarm time and date with the \'Time and Date Wheel\' at the bottom of the screen. 3 Click on the \'Set Alarm\' button. The sounds will stop and the alarm time that you set will be displayed at the \'Alarm Time\' label. The sounds and settings are saved and replayed when the alarm time arrives.
Clicking on the \'Snooze Button\' will temporarily silence the alarm. The alarm will return after the selected snooze time runs out.
The \'Alarm Time\' label will display the alarm time selected. Clicking on the label will stop the alarm sounds and the alarm function.
The \'Time and Date Wheel\' is used to select the date and time of the alarm before clicking on \'Set Alarm\'.
Use the number keys on the keypad to enter the time you want the timer to countdown from.
Use the Delete button to erase numbers.

Click on the \'Start\' button to start the timer. Once the timer reaches zero all of the sounds will be stopped. The \'Pause\' button will stop the timer and can be restarted by clicking \'Start\' again. Click the \'Reset\' button to erase the time.
